title: Clio persistence and local Wiki stack: implementation handoff
body:
**Superseded for review by the [23-PR split and task index](https://github.com/open-hax/knoxx/issues/323).** This original PR is retained as the immutable source/handoff reference, has been returned to draft, and has auto-merge disabled. The split stack exactly reconstructs this head; use the bounded PRs for CodeRabbit review. Current-main reconciliation is tracked in #324, qualification and browser acceptance in #325.

---

This draft preserves the published Knoxx foundation/application work and records the current handoff after the user asked to stop pursuing browser acceptance.

**Start here:** [Application handoff](https://github.com/open-hax/knoxx/blob/1d3b207ab2e5bfc6b2fa149836b855d458a9c997/docs/verification/sandbox-handoff-2026-09-13.md), [full experience report](https://github.com/open-hax/foresight/blob/f77a945f836b5cfbfddfd0fdaff8cfdecb74b3c7/docs/notes/sandbox-handoff-2026-09-13.md), and [Drive handoff folder]([private external reference]).

Application source checkpoint: 530b1db992e3c1373d3427263c1d708582319911. Documentation successor: 1d3b207ab2e5bfc6b2fa149836b855d458a9c997. The documentation does not add later local-only code removed by workspace cleanup.

This work began with canonical Clio accepted-operation replay, persistence/identity/source contracts, backend build prerequisites and guards against falsely successful native async test runs. The published diff grew substantially; the earlier foundation-only PR description was no longer an adequate handoff.

The last browser run reached real identity/admin/Mail/Contracts, AI writing, source review/acceptance, agent MCP/SSE updates and stale-source publication refusal. It failed after 7m42s waiting for translation, with an older revision running and a newer revision queued. Two complete publication cycles were not proved. The tested browser snapshot included unpublished local changes, so it is not acceptance evidence for this PR head.

Historical local checks are documented with their exact limits. Frontend typecheck/build/configured lint and Vitest passed (276 pass, 41 todo). CLJS ran 526 tests / 2,282 assertions with one stale generated-manifest failure. Its local repair's rerun completion is unavailable. The broader backend slices are not a completed whole combined backend gate. Earlier foundation counts and lint failures remain history, not superseded by an invented final pass.

Later local changes, including browser diagnostics, embedding cause classification, runtime/static repairs, Zen composition and process-lifecycle fixes, were not recovered or published. The known local IDs and last observed results are recorded for recovery. The previously saved 33-screenshot browser archive is also unavailable for retrieval in this turn.

Canonical child work is separately published in eta-mu #334/#333, with further current Axxium and Epiphany review findings and a Rheos integration conflict recorded in the fresh audit. Reviews have not converged. This PR remains draft and unmerged; no new build/test/model/browser run was performed for the documentation handoff.
